mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO backtest_daily (task_id, trade_date, nav, cash, market_value, benchmark_nav, drawdown, created_at) VALUES
(#{it.taskId}, #{it.tradeDate}, #{it.nav}, #{it.cash}, #{it.marketValue}, #{it.benchmarkNav}, #{it.drawdown}, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'))
ON CONFLICT (task_id, trade_date) DO UPDATE SET nav = excluded.nav, cash = excluded.cash, market_value = excluded.market_value, benchmark_nav = excluded.benchmark_nav, drawdown = excluded.drawdown
mapper.select: SELECT task_id, trade_date, nav, cash, market_value, benchmark_nav, drawdown FROM backtest_daily WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY trade_date
